thread:
arik: Noticing spike in Pending GPU pods in ap-northeast1a around 08:03. Many tiny jobs (~0.25 GPU).
nora: Any scheduler errors?
chris: kube-scheduler shows lots of 'AffinityConflict' and 'node had taint preempt-protect=true'. Also kubelet logs show NIC attach timeouts (~120s).
arik: Ops-bot shows switch firmware patch at 08:00 that triggered kubelet restarts. Some nodes lost gpu.class label and scheduler rejects pods.
nora: Short mitigations: (1) run label-sync daemonset to reapply gpu.class, (2) bump warm-pool +2, (3) add namespace toleration for preempt-protect with tolerationSeconds=900.
chris: I'll roll label-sync DS now. Example: `kubectl apply -f label-sync-ds.yaml`.
devops-bot: autoscaler: warmpool target increased by 2 in ap-ne1a. alert created ap-ne1a-gpu-pending threshold=25/10m.
arik: Good. Monitor pending count + attach latency. We'll revert tolerations after 15m.
chris: Early telemetry: pending down ~35%, attach latencies from 140s -> 45s after label sync.
nora: Postmortem items: make gpu.class persistent on node boot, evaluate fractional GPU packing admission, smarter attach-detach backoff.
arik: Action items assigned: chris+nora scheduler sim, ops revert tolerations, infra patch node bootstrap. Close thread when pending <5 for 20m.
